lines.text: 옛날 옛날, 깊은 산골에 팥죽을 아주 잘 쑤는 할멈이 살았어요.
lines.en: Once upon a time, deep in the mountains, there lived an old grandma who made the yummiest red bean porridge.
segs: Once upon a time, deep in the mountains, there lived an old grandma who made the yummiest red bean porridge.

lines.text: 어흥! 어느 날 커다란 호랑이가 나타났어요. "할멈, 잡아먹어야겠다!"
lines.en: Roar! One day, a big tiger appeared. Grandma, I'm going to eat you up!
segs: Roar! One day, a big tiger appeared.
Grandma, I'm going to eat you up!

lines.text: "호랑이야, 동짓날에 맛있는 팥죽을 쑤어 줄게. 그때까지 기다려 다오." 호랑이는 어슬렁어슬렁 돌아갔어요.
lines.en: Tiger, on the longest night of the year, I'll cook you some yummy red bean porridge. Please wait until then. The tiger prowled away, slow and heavy.
segs: Tiger, on the longest night of the year, I'll cook you some yummy red bean porridge. Please wait until then.
The tiger prowled away, slow and heavy.

lines.text: 드디어 동짓날이 되었어요. 할멈은 팥죽을 쑤면서 훌쩍훌쩍 울었어요.
lines.en: At last, the longest night came. Grandma cooked the porridge, and she sniffled and cried.
segs: At last, the longest night came. Grandma cooked the porridge, and she sniffled and cried.

lines.text: 깜깜한 밤이 되었어요. 어흥! 호랑이가 어슬렁어슬렁 찾아왔어요!
lines.en: It was a dark, dark night. Roar! The tiger came prowling back!
segs: It was a dark, dark night. Roar! The tiger came prowling back!

lines.text: "얘들아, 도와줘!" 친구들을 순서대로 눌러서 호랑이를 혼내 주세요!
lines.en: Friends, help me! Tap your friends, one after another, to give that tiger a lesson!
segs: Tap your friends, one after another, to give that tiger a lesson!

lines.text: 데굴데굴~ 알밤이 굴러왔어요. "할멈, 팥죽 한 그릇 주면 도와줄게!" 알밤은 팥죽을 얻어먹고 뜨거운 아궁이 속에 쏙 숨었어요.
lines.en: Roll, roll, roll! Chestnut came rolling in. Grandma, give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help you! Chestnut ate the porridge, then hid deep inside the hot fireplace.
segs: Roll, roll, roll! Chestnut came rolling in.
Grandma, give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help you!
Chestnut ate the porridge, then hid deep inside the hot fireplace.

lines.text: 알밤이 아궁이에서 톡! 튀어나와 호랑이 눈을 딱 때렸어요!
lines.en: Chestnut popped out of the fireplace — pop! — and bonked the tiger right in the eye!
segs: Chestnut popped out of the fireplace — pop! — and bonked the tiger right in the eye!

lines.text: 알밤이 톡 튀어나왔지만, 호랑이는 아궁이 앞에 없었어요!
lines.en: Chestnut popped out — pop! — but the tiger wasn't by the fireplace!
segs: Chestnut popped out — pop! — but the tiger wasn't by the fireplace!

lines.text: 엉금엉금~ 자라가 기어왔어요. "나도 팥죽 한 그릇 주면 도와줄게!" 자라는 팥죽을 얻어먹고 물독 속에 퐁당 숨었어요.
lines.en: Slow and steady! Turtle came crawling in. Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help too! Turtle ate the porridge, then slipped into the water jar to hide.
segs: Slow and steady! Turtle came crawling in.
Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help too!
Turtle ate the porridge, then slipped into the water jar to hide.

lines.text: 물독 속 자라가 호랑이 입을 앙! 물었어요!
lines.en: Turtle, hiding in the water jar, bit the tiger's mouth — chomp!
segs: Turtle, hiding in the water jar, bit the tiger's mouth — chomp!

lines.text: 자라가 물독에서 두리번두리번… 호랑이 얼굴이 없네요!
lines.en: Turtle peeked out of the water jar, looking this way and that... no tiger face in sight!
segs: Turtle peeked out of the water jar, looking this way and that... no tiger face in sight!

lines.text: 철퍼덕! 쇠똥이 왔어요. "팥죽 한 그릇 주면 나도 도울게!" 쇠똥은 팥죽을 얻어먹고 부엌 바닥에 납작 엎드려 숨었어요.
lines.en: Splat! Cow Plop arrived. Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help too! Cow Plop ate the porridge, then lay flat on the kitchen floor to hide.
segs: Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help too!
Cow Plop ate the porridge, then lay flat on the kitchen floor to hide.

lines.text: 호랑이가 쇠똥을 밟고 쭈르륵~ 미끄러졌어요!
lines.en: The tiger stepped on Cow Plop and slip-slid-slipped away!
segs: The tiger stepped on Cow Plop and slip-slid-slipped away!

lines.text: 호랑이가 쇠똥을 폴짝 뛰어넘어 버렸어요!
lines.en: The tiger hopped right over Cow Plop!
segs: The tiger hopped right over Cow Plop!

lines.text: 콕콕! 송곳이 왔어요. "팥죽 한 그릇 주면 도와줄게!" 송곳은 팥죽을 얻어먹고 바닥 틈에 뾰족 숨었어요.
lines.en: Poke, poke! Awl arrived. Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help! Awl ate the porridge, then hid, pointy and still, in a crack in the floor.
segs: Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help!
Awl ate the porridge, then hid, pointy and still, in a crack in the floor.

lines.text: 송곳이 호랑이 엉덩이를 콕! 찔렀어요!
lines.en: Awl gave the tiger's bottom a poke!
segs: Awl gave the tiger's bottom a poke!

lines.text: 송곳이 콕! 찔렀지만, 호랑이는 저쪽에 있네요.
lines.en: Awl poked — poke! — but the tiger was over there.
segs: Awl poked — poke! — but the tiger was over there.

lines.text: 쿵더쿵! 절구가 왔어요. "팥죽 한 그릇 주면 도와줄게!" 절구는 팥죽을 얻어먹고 문 위로 올라가 숨었어요.
lines.en: Thump-a-thump! Mortar arrived. Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help! Mortar ate the porridge, then climbed up above the door to hide.
segs: Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help!
Mortar ate the porridge, then climbed up above the door to hide.

lines.text: 절구가 문 위에서 쿵! 호랑이 머리 위로 떨어졌어요!
lines.en: Mortar fell from above the door — thump! — right on the tiger's head!
segs: Mortar fell from above the door — thump! — right on the tiger's head!

lines.text: 절구가 쿵! 떨어졌지만 호랑이를 못 맞혔어요!
lines.en: Mortar fell — thump! — but missed the tiger!
segs: Mortar fell — thump! — but missed the tiger!

lines.text: 펄럭펄럭~ 멍석이 왔어요. "팥죽 한 그릇 주면 도와줄게!" 멍석은 팥죽을 얻어먹고 마당에 돌돌 말려 숨었어요.
lines.en: Flap, flap! Straw Mat arrived. Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help! Straw Mat ate the porridge, then rolled up tight in the yard to hide.
segs: Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help!
Straw Mat ate the porridge, then rolled up tight in the yard to hide.

lines.text: 멍석이 호랑이를 돌돌돌 말아 버렸어요!
lines.en: Straw Mat rolled the tiger up, round and round and round!
segs: Straw Mat rolled the tiger up, round and round and round!

lines.text: 멍석이 펄럭펄럭… 아무것도 못 말았어요!
lines.en: Straw Mat flapped and flapped... and didn't roll up a thing!
segs: Straw Mat flapped and flapped... and didn't roll up a thing!

lines.text: 성큼성큼! 지게가 왔어요. "팥죽 한 그릇 주면 도와줄게!" 지게는 팥죽을 얻어먹고 담벼락에 기대어 숨었어요.
lines.en: Stomp, stomp! Carrier came striding in. Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help! Carrier ate the porridge, then leaned against the garden wall to hide.
segs: Stomp, stomp! Carrier came striding in.
Give me a bowl of red bean porridge and I'll help!
Carrier ate the porridge, then leaned against the garden wall to hide.

lines.text: 지게가 호랑이를 번쩍 지고 가서 바다에 풍덩! 던져 버렸어요!
lines.en: Carrier hoisted the tiger up, carried the tiger off, and — splash! — tossed the tiger into the sea!
segs: Carrier hoisted the tiger up, carried the tiger off, and — splash! — tossed the tiger into the sea!

lines.text: 지게가 낑낑… 힘센 호랑이를 들 수가 없어요!
lines.en: Carrier groaned and strained... the strong tiger was too heavy to lift!
segs: Carrier groaned and strained... the strong tiger was too heavy to lift!

lines.text: "호랑아, 팥죽 먹기 전에 아궁이 불 좀 봐주렴." 할멈의 말에 호랑이가 아궁이 앞에 쪼그려 앉았어요. 누가 먼저 혼내 줄까요?
lines.en: Tiger, before we eat the porridge, please watch the fire for me. At Grandma's words, the tiger squatted down by the fireplace. Who should teach the tiger a lesson first?
segs: Tiger, before we eat the porridge, please watch the fire for me.
At Grandma's words, the tiger squatted down by the fireplace. Who should teach the tiger a lesson first?

lines.text: "앗, 뜨거워! 눈이야!" 호랑이가 눈을 씻으려고 물독에 얼굴을 쏙 넣었어요. 다음은 누구일까요?
lines.en: Ow, hot! My eyes! The tiger dunked its face into the water jar to wash its eyes. Who's next?
segs: The tiger dunked its face into the water jar to wash its eyes. Who's next?

lines.text: "아야야!" 호랑이가 깜짝 놀라 뒷걸음질을 쳤어요. 다음은 누구죠?
lines.en: Yowch! The tiger jumped in surprise and stumbled backward. Who's next?
segs: The tiger jumped in surprise and stumbled backward. Who's next?

lines.text: 미끌! 호랑이가 꽈당 넘어졌어요. 이번엔 누구일까요?
lines.en: Slip! The tiger went crash — flat on the floor! Who is it this time?
segs: Slip! The tiger went crash — flat on the floor! Who is it this time?

lines.text: "엉엉, 아파!" 호랑이가 문 쪽으로 도망가요. 다음은 누구?
lines.en: Boo-hoo, that hurts! The tiger ran away toward the door. Who's next?
segs: The tiger ran away toward the door. Who's next?

lines.text: 쿵! 절구에 맞은 호랑이가 마당으로 도망쳐 쭉 뻗어 버렸어요. 이제 누구 차례죠?
lines.en: Thump! Hit by the Mortar, the tiger ran out into the yard and stretched out flat. Whose turn is it now?
segs: Thump! Hit by the Mortar, the tiger ran out into the yard and stretched out flat. Whose turn is it now?

lines.text: 돌돌돌! 호랑이가 멍석에 꽁꽁 말렸어요. 마지막은 누구일까요?
lines.en: Round and round! The tiger got rolled up tight in the Straw Mat. Who's last?
segs: Round and round! The tiger got rolled up tight in the Straw Mat. Who's last?

lines.text: 만세! 호랑이를 물리쳤어요! 할멈은 친구들과 맛있는 팥죽을 나누어 먹었답니다.
lines.en: Hooray! The tiger was beaten! Grandma shared yummy red bean porridge with all her friends.
segs: Hooray! The tiger was beaten! Grandma shared yummy red bean porridge with all her friends.

lines.text: 친구들을 톡 눌러서 인사해 봐요!
lines.en: Tap your friends to say hello!
segs: Tap your friends to say hello!

lines.text: 호랑이는 아궁이 앞에 있어요. 아궁이 속에 누가 숨었지?
lines.en: The tiger is by the fireplace. Who is hiding inside the fireplace?
segs: The tiger is by the fireplace. Who is hiding inside the fireplace?

lines.text: 알밤을 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Tap Chestnut!

lines.text: 호랑이가 물독에 얼굴을 넣었어요. 물독 속에 누가 숨었지?
lines.en: The tiger dunked its face in the water jar. Who is hiding in the water jar?
segs: The tiger dunked its face in the water jar. Who is hiding in the water jar?

lines.text: 자라를 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Tap Turtle!

lines.text: 호랑이가 부엌 바닥으로 뒷걸음질! 바닥에 납작 숨은 친구는 누구지?
lines.en: The tiger is backing up onto the kitchen floor! Who is hiding flat on the floor?
segs: The tiger is backing up onto the kitchen floor! Who is hiding flat on the floor?

lines.text: 쇠똥을 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Tap Cow Plop!

lines.text: 호랑이가 바닥에 꽈당 넘어졌어요. 바닥 틈에 뾰족 숨은 친구는 누구지?
lines.en: The tiger fell flat on the floor. Who is hiding, all pointy, in a crack in the floor?
segs: The tiger fell flat on the floor. Who is hiding, all pointy, in a crack in the floor?

lines.text: 송곳을 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Tap Awl!

lines.text: 호랑이는 문 앞에 있어요. 문 위에 누가 숨었지?
lines.en: The tiger is by the door. Who is hiding above the door?
segs: The tiger is by the door. Who is hiding above the door?

lines.text: 절구를 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Tap Mortar!

lines.text: 호랑이가 마당에 쭉 뻗었어요. 마당에 돌돌 말려 숨은 친구는 누구지?
lines.en: The tiger is stretched out in the yard. Who is hiding, rolled up, in the yard?
segs: The tiger is stretched out in the yard. Who is hiding, rolled up, in the yard?

lines.text: 멍석을 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Tap Straw Mat!

lines.text: 호랑이가 멍석에 꽁꽁 말렸어요. 담벼락에 기대 숨은 친구는 누구지?
lines.en: The tiger is rolled up tight in the Straw Mat. Who is hiding against the wall?
segs: The tiger is rolled up tight in the Straw Mat. Who is hiding against the wall?

lines.text: 지게를 눌러 봐요!
lines.en: Tap Carrier!

cut_bam: Chestnut pops out of the fireplace!
Chestnut popped out and bonked the tiger right in the eye!
cut_jara: Turtle bites the tiger's mouth from the water jar!
Ow, ow, ow! My mouth! Let go, let go!
cut_ddong: The tiger backs up and steps on Cow Plop!
The tiger stepped on Cow Plop and slipped!
cut_jeolgu: Mortar falls from above the door!
Mortar fell right on the tiger's head!
cut_myeongseok: Round and round, roll up tight!
Straw Mat rolls up the tiger!
Ugh, I can't move! Let me out!
Straw Mat rolled the tiger up tight!
cut_jige: Heave-ho! Off to the sea — splash!
Carrier throws the rolled-up tiger into the sea!
The tiger fell into the sea with a splash!
cut_jige_b: Help! Somebody help! I'll never do it again!
Carrier tossed the tiger into the sea with a splash!
cut_wrong_1: A friend missed. The tiger laughs.
cut_wrong_2: Hee hee, that doesn't hurt one bit!
A friend missed. The tiger teases.
oops_bam: Huh? Where did the tiger go?
oops_ddong: Aw, you didn't step on me!
oops_songgot: Huh? I only poked the air!
hi_bam: Thank you, Grandma! Best porridge ever!
hi_ddong: Hee hee, I'm so excited too!
hi_halmi: Thank you, my dears! Let's all eat porridge together!

ui.팥죽할멈과 호랑이: The Tiger and the Red Bean Porridge
ui.친구들을 순서대로 불러서 호랑이를 물리쳐요!: Call your friends in order and send the tiger packing!
ui.친구들이 힘을 모아 호랑이를 물리쳤어요!: The friends joined forces and beat the tiger!
